Applying
Applying
From core computational theory to real-world applications and emerging technologies, our computer science programs prepare students to lead in a rapidly evolving field. Admission to our graduate programs is selective and competitive.
Apply Online Today!
Application Process
Our PhD and MS programs have different deadlines and financial support, so please read through the process for the program you’d like to apply to.
Applicants to the PhD program may have either a Bachelors or Masters degree.
Both programs have a $70 application fee.
PhD Application Details
Deadlines
All application materials, along with the application fee, are due January 5, 2027.
Application Process
Applicants submit all required materials through the online admissions portal.
A committee reviews and ranks applications. Applicants may be contacted for interviews and informational meetings.
Admission offers will be made after the application deadline until the incoming class is filled.
Financial Information
The department provides health insurance, a stipend, and pays tuition costs for PhD students in good academic standing.
To increase your stipend and improve your chances of admission, US applicants are encouraged to apply to national graduate fellowship programs.
Application Fee Waiver
Our program has a $70 application fee. A limited number of partial application waivers are available. Interested students should submit a complete admission application, via the application portal, then contact us for additional information.
Contact
Email gradadmissions@cs.rochester.edu with any questions.
MS Application Details
Deadlines
The deadline for fall 2027 admission is February 15, 2027. All required materials (including transcripts and letters of recommendation) must arrive before the deadline.
All MS decisions will be made after the deadline and should be released by mid-March.
Application Fee Waiver
There is a $70 fee for MS applications. Applicants may request a waiver of the application fee in cases of financial hardship. After submitting a complete application, with all materials except for payment, an applicant may email a request explaining their special circumstances to our master's program coordinator at nquattro@cs.rochester.edu.
Financial Information
Funding is not guaranteed for MA or MS students. A tuition award (merit scholarship for reduced tuition) may be available for some of the strongest applicants in our masters program. Decisions will be made upon admission to the program.
Applicants will be responsible for raising the difference between any departmental tuition award and full tuition. For further information on tuition, please visit the Office of the Bursar’s website and consult the graduate tuition rates, under "Arts and Sciences & Hajim;” note that our MS has a minimum of 30 credit hours.
For more information on financial aid and scholarships, please visit the Financial Aid Office’s website. The graduate studies office has a Costs and Financial Support section on its website that can also be helpful.
We do not offer full scholarships or teaching assistantships to MS students.
Contact
Email gradadmissions@cs.rochester.edu with any questions.
Application Materials
The following materials are required for PhD and MS applications:
Statement of purpose: Read the statement of purpose guidelines below carefully before submitting
Transcripts: Please upload scans of your unofficial transcripts to your application, official transcripts will only be required if you are admitted.
GRE scores: GRE Scores are optional, but encouraged, for both the PhD and MS applications. Official scores should be submitted from the GRE website using code 2928.
English language proficiency scores: International students must submit their exam (TOEFL, TOEFL iBT Home Edition, IELTS, Duolingo) results unless they meet the requirements listed in the English Language Proficiency Exam Waiver below.
Three letters of recommendation
There is no specific minimum threshold on GRE or English language proficiency scores. The admission decision is made based on the overall application package.
Statement of Purpose
PhD Statements
Clearly describe:
Any past research experiences
How your training has prepared you for conducting research
A high-level discussion of the research areas you'd like to pursue
Indicate any interests and rationale for working in a particular lab or with a specific faculty member. You are also welcome to share additional information you believe to be relevant for the admissions committee in reviewing your application.
MS Statements
You should clearly describe your:
Reasons for applying to the University of Rochester
Preparation for your field of study
Research/professional interests
You may explain how your unique experiences will shape your future pursuits in your chosen field. Please share any information you think is relevant for the admissions committee to evaluate your application.
English Language Proficiency Exam Waiver
The English proficiency test requirement is waived for citizens of the following countries:
Australia
Canada
Commonwealth Caribbean Nations
Ghana
Ireland
Kenya
Liberia
New Zealand
Nigeria
Singapore
South Africa
Uganda
UK
Virgin Islands
The requirement may also be waived if a student has completed at least three years of postsecondary study in one of the countries listed above or the United States. Scores more than two years old from the application deadline are not valid.
We reserve the right to require demonstration of English proficiency, even if you have received your degree from one of the above mentioned countries.
How to Submit your Exam Scores
GRE and TOEFL scores can be submitted using the code 2928.
Duolingo scores can be submitted by selecting the University of Rochester as the recipient of the scores.
For IELTS scores:
You can have the testing center send your IELTS scores either electronically or have them mailed directly to our institution. Please check with your local testing center for how your scores can be sent.
To electronically send your results select University of Rochester Graduate Studies – AS&E as the University.
To physically send in IELTS scores please use the following address:
University of Rochester
Graduate Studies – AS&E
500 Joseph C. Wilson Blvd
P.O. Box 270401
Rochester NY 14627
